extension.description: Platform-independent Simkl and Context Menu updates. Elementum is installed separately.

Simkl is an experimental GPL fork of Otaku, with Simkl watchlists, manual watch-history updates, and anime playback. Original code by SwagOtaku and Otaku contributors. Movie and TV playback is under development. Includes provider discovery and public-domain film search. No media is hosted by this add-on.
